decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is close to the core and benefits from growing organic demand, so the option remains worth keeping at low cost.
Organic smoked pork is a low-cost line extension with still-uncertain niche demand, so keeping the option alive is justified.
Organic pepper salami is close to established products and its option value remains positive despite modest uncertainty.
The exotic aspic specialty has had enough time to prove itself and its demand appears insufficient to justify further commitment.
Fennel salami is a low-cost flavor variant whose niche appeal remains uncertain and worth carrying further.
Liver pâté with veal is a classic premium line extension with low downside and ongoing option value.
